items.title: Football's Minicucci Named CUSA Co-Offensive Player of the Week and a Manning Star of the Week
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – University of Delaware football QB Nick Minicucci has been named Conference USA's Co-Offensive Player of the Week and one of the Manning Award Stars of the Week for his performance against New Mexico State, the league and Allstate Sugar Bowl Committee announced Monday. It is a league-high fourth time this season that Minicucci has earned the CUSA weekly honor and second time being named a star of the week.

items.title: Football's Minicucci Earns Spot on Davey O’Brien Great 8 in Week 12
items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas – University of Delaware football QB Nick Minicucci has been named to the Davey O'Brien Great 8 for Week 12, the Davey O'Brien Foundation announced Monday. This week marked Minicucci's third appearance on the list this season.

items.title: Minicucci Sets UD Career-Passing Touchdown Record in Football’s 42-30 Win at NM State; Hens Bowl Eligible for Second-Straight Season
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – QB Nick Minicucci set the Delaware career passing touchdowns record with his third of the afternoon as the University of Delaware football team defeated New Mexico State, 42-30, on Saturday at Aggie Memorial Stadium. The Fightin' Blue Hens improve to 6-5, 4-3 CUSA, while the Aggies fall to 3-8, 2-5 CUSA. UD is now bowl-eligible for the second-consecutive season.

items.title: Football's Demboski Named to 2026 CUSA All-Academic Team
items.summary: University of Delaware football OL Steven Demboski has been named to the 2026 CUSA Football All-Academic Team, the league office announced Friday. The fifth year graduate student is one of the 11 members of this year's squad and Demboski becomes the third player in program history to make the team (Kyre Duplessis and Jake Thaw, 2025).

items.title: Football Looks to Become Bowl-Eligible for Second-Straight Season at New Mexico State
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – The University of Delaware football team will travel to Las Cruces, N.M. to take on the New Mexico State Aggies on Saturday, November 21 at 3 p.m. ET on ESPN+. This will be the first-ever meeting between the two programs. Delaware is on the verge of six wins, which would make it bowl-eligible for the second-consecutive season.

items.title: Football's Minicucci Earns CUSA Offensive Player of the Week for Third Time
items.summary: DALLAS – University of Delaware football QB Nick Minicucci has been named Conference USA's Offensive Player of the Week for his performance against FIU, the league announced Monday. It is the third time this season that Minicucci has earned the league's weekly honor.

items.title: Minicucci Sets Completion-Percentage Record, Defense Stands Tall in Football’s 24-16 Win Over FIU
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – QB Nick Minicucci completed 27-of-30 passes (90-percent), setting the Delaware single-game completion percentage record with at least 25 pass attempts as the University of Delaware football team took down FIU, 24-16, on Saturday evening at Delaware Stadium. The Fightin' Blue Hens rise to 5-5, 3-3 CUSA, while the Panthers rise to 4-6, 2-4 CUSA.

items.title: Football Celebrates 80th Anniversary of First National Championship Heading into Homecoming
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – The 1946 Delaware football season was a triumphant return to the gridiron after three seasons without a team during World War II. William "Bill" Murray's Fightin' Blue Hens came back stronger than ever, rolling to a 10-0 record, a program best at the time, and claiming the 1946 AP College Division National Championship, the first of six national championships for UD. items.title: Football Hosts FIU for Homecoming
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – The University of Delaware football team will host the FIU Panthers for Homecoming on Saturday, November 14 at 3 p.m. on ESPN+. This will be the second meeting all-time between the two programs, as Delaware won the inaugural matchup last season, 38-16.

items.title: Football Falls at Kennesaw State
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – The University of Delaware football team was in position to tie the game with a two-point conversion attempt late in the fourth quarter, but ultimately fell to Kennesaw State, 42-40, on Saturday evening at Fifth Third Stadium. The Fightin' Blue Hens drop to 4-5, 2-3 CUSA, while the Owls rise to 3-6 2-3 CUSA.
